basic_profile.bio: I'm a fresh face in the Reddit community, diving into the world of cryptocurrencies and new tech. Originally from Austin, TX, I work as a junior sales engineer by day and explore the depths of the digital currency world by night. I enjoy learning about the latest gadgets and advancements in technology, and I'm a huge fan of the Houston Astros. When I'm not working or online, I like to catch up on the latest anime series. I'm single and usually online in the evenings, around 8 PM to midnight. My weekends are reserved for exploring local tech meetups and sometimes dabbling in photography.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, which gives me a foundational understanding of technology and systems. My interest in Bitcoin and cryptocurrencies is relatively new, and I’m mostly self-taught through online resources like YouTube videos and blogs. I'm still getting the hang of the technical jargon and advanced concepts.
